overview: The Medford School Committee reviewed high school safety updates, student achievements, and administrative reports. The committee approved travel for the Ethics Bowl team, accepted the 2023–2024 school calendar, passed a school naming policy on first reading, and requested an immediate action plan to address high school track program needs.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Evaluation Process Timeline
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes as amended to include a June 1 draft deadline for the superintendent's composite evaluation.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates and Comments
items.summary: Received updates from the superintendent on athletic accomplishments, Black History Month events, academic awards, and upcoming community events.

items.title: Ethics Bowl Team Travel Approval
items.summary: Approved out-of-state travel and funding for the Medford High School Ethics Bowl team to compete at the National High School Ethics Bowl in North Carolina.

items.title: Report on DESE Grant Awarded to MVTHS
items.summary: Received a report on a $320,000 DESE Skills Capital Grant awarded to update equipment in the metal fabrication program at Medford Vocational Technical High School.

items.title: Report on Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility (CCSR)
items.summary: Received an update on CCSR student projects and passed a motion requiring an inclusive outreach plan for high school enrollment by May 15, 2023.

items.title: Public Presentation: Track Team Equipment and Staffing Concerns
items.summary: Heard presentations from track athletes and parents regarding unsafe equipment and insufficient coaching staff, and requested an immediate action plan and historical stipend report for the next meeting.

items.title: 2023-2024 School Year Calendar Approval
items.summary: Approved the proposed 2023–2024 school year calendar incorporating updated holiday observances.

items.title: Update on 10-Point Action Plan at Medford High School
items.summary: Received a progress update on the high school safety and culture action plan, with members agreeing to submit follow-up questions for a future meeting.

items.title: Continued Business: School Committee Goals
items.summary: Tabled the discussion regarding the school committee's goal-setting timeline until the next meeting.

items.title: First Reading: Policy for Naming School Facilities (Policy FF)
items.summary: Approved the first reading of Policy FF governing the dedication and naming of school buildings, grounds, and interior spaces as amended.

items.title: School Closure Announcement and Condolences
items.summary: Announced that Medford Public Schools would be closed the following day due to an impending snowstorm and expressed condolences to bereaved families.
